statutes.act_name: UAE Civil Code (Federal Decree-Law No. 42 of 2022)
statutes.title: Decennial Liability for Structural Building Collapse
statutes.description: Joint 10-year strict liability of contractor and architect for total or partial collapse or structural defects of buildings and skyscraper structures.
statutes.penalty: Full compensation for reconstruction costs, property damage, and losses.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 34/2021 on Combatting Rumors & Cybercrimes
statutes.title: Violation of Privacy, Unpermitted Filming & Online Insults
statutes.description: Capturing, filming, or broadcasting video/photos of any person at airport, public, or private place without consent, or sending abusive swearing / emojis online.
statutes.penalty: Detention not less than 6 months and fine between AED 150,000 to AED 500,000, and deportation for expats.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 50/2022 Commercial Transactions Law
statutes.title: Bounced Cheques & Cheque Drawn on Closed Corporate Account
statutes.description: Drawing, issuing, or signing a commercial check without sufficient funds or on a closed bank account with bad faith.
statutes.penalty: Fine between AED 20,000 to AED 100,000, travel ban, and civil enforcement order.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 33/2021 on Regulation of Labour Relations
statutes.title: Arbitrary Termination & End of Service Gratuity
statutes.description: Termination of employment without notice, unlawful dismissal, or withholding statutory end-of-service gratuity calculation.
statutes.penalty: Compensation up to 3 months gross salary plus full end-of-service gratuity payout.

statutes.act_name: Dubai Law No. 12 of 2004 & DIFC Judicial Authority Law
statutes.title: DIFC Court Jurisdiction & Commercial Contract Dispute
statutes.description: Jurisdiction of DIFC Courts over civil and commercial disputes involving DIFC-registered entities or opt-in commercial contracts.
statutes.penalty: DIFC Court judgment, injunction, and worldwide asset enforcement.

statutes.act_name: Dubai Law No. 26 of 2007 (Landlord and Tenant Relationship)
statutes.title: Prohibition of Landlord Disconnecting Services or Changing Locks
statutes.description: Unlawful eviction, lock code changes, or utility disconnection by landlord to force tenant eviction without Rental Dispute Center order.
statutes.penalty: RDC police enforcement, restoration of access, and tenant compensation.

statutes.act_name: Federal Law No. 11/2021 Protection of Industrial Property Rights
statutes.title: Counterfeiting Registered Trademarks & Brand Logos
statutes.description: Manufacturing, stocking, or selling counterfeit luxury bags, apparel, or commercial products bearing fake registered trademarks.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment, fine up to AED 1,000,000, and destruction of counterfeit stock.

statutes.act_name: Federal Law No. 4/2016 on Medical Liability
statutes.title: Medical Malpractice, Gross Negligence & Wrong Dosage
statutes.description: Failure of medical practitioner to exercise due care, issuing incorrect medication dosage, or gross surgical negligence causing cardiac arrest or injury.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years, fine up to AED 500,000, medical license revocation, and civil compensation.

statutes.title: Import & Possession of Psychotropic Pills Without Prescription
statutes.description: Carrying or importing restricted narcotic or psychotropic pills into UAE border checkpoints without authenticated Ministry medical prescription.
statutes.penalty: Detention not less than 3 months, fine, mandatory deportation for non-citizens.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 31/2021 Crimes and Penalties
statutes.title: Fraud, Embezzlement & Double Booking Real Estate
statutes.description: Deceiving persons by using fraudulent names, fake real estate authority, or taking multiple deposits for the same apartment property.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

statutes.act_name: UAE Federal Traffic Law & Federal Decree-Law No. 31/2021 (Penal Code)
statutes.title: Reckless Driving, Red Light Collision & Diyah Liability
statutes.description: Running red signals at city intersections, causing severe injury or bodily harm to pedestrians, establishing traffic fines and Diyah compensation liability.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment, black points, vehicle impoundment, and Diyah compensation Payout.

statutes.act_name: MOHRE Midday Work Ban & Federal Decree-Law No. 33/2021
statutes.title: Violation of Peak Summer Midday Work Ban
statutes.description: Forcing field laborers to work in open outdoor sites or skyscraper scaffolds under direct sunlight between 12:30 PM and 3:00 PM during peak summer months.
statutes.penalty: Fine of AED 5,000 per worker up to AED 50,000 and company suspension.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 31/2021 Crimes and Penalties
statutes.title: Anti-discrimination, Religious Insult & Blasphemy
statutes.description: Publishing videos, posts, or media mocking, insulting, or trivializing spiritual practices, sacred figures, or recognized global religions.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment not less than 5 years and fine between AED 250,000 to AED 1,000,000, and deportation.

statutes.act_name: Dubai Executive Council Resolution No. 6 of 2010 & Dubai RERA Regulations
statutes.title: Dubai Executive Council Resolution No. 6 of 2010 & Dubai RERA Regulations
statutes.description: Developer completely stopping work, deserting construction site, or abandoning residential master-planned community for more than 24 months, triggering RERA project cancellation, liquidation committee, and buyer refund proceedings.
statutes.penalty: Project cancellation, developer liquidation, and mandatory refund of buyer deposits.

statutes.act_name: UAE Federal Law No. 3 of 2021 on Regulating Fundraising Activities
statutes.title: Unauthorized Online Charity, Instagram Fundraising & Animal Rescue Donations
statutes.description: Setting up unauthorized charity websites, Instagram accounts, or public financial donation campaigns for private animal rescue missions or non-permitted fundraising without licensing.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment, fine between AED 200,000 to AED 500,000, and confiscation of collected funds.

statutes.act_name: Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection
statutes.title: Consumer Right to Safety, 14-day Refund / Return & Repair Guarantee
statutes.description: Electronics stores refusing 14-day return/refund for defective smart TVs or refrigerators, AC repair companies taking advance but failing to fix cooling, defective maintenance, or service provider non-performance.
statutes.penalty: Mandatory refund, product replacement, fine between AED 10,000 to AED 100,000 imposed by DED Consumer Rights.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 50 of 2022 Commercial Transactions Law
statutes.title: Unfulfilled Commercial Advance Payments & Non-performance of Service Contract
statutes.description: Service companies, AC repair vendors, contractors, or technicians taking advance money but failing to complete service or perform contract obligations.
statutes.penalty: Refund of advance payment, legal interest, and commercial damages.
